# Maison Botanique

> Maison Botanique is a Dubai floral gifting house: hand-tied bouquets, roses, vase and box arrangements, preserved flowers, and flower-and-gift sets
> (chocolates, teddies, makeup and beauty gifts). Each arrangement is offered in three sizes: Signature, Grand (double the quantity) and Luxe (triple).
